description: This file defines a SwiftUI view component called 'MenuHostedItem' that hosts arbitrary SwiftUI content as an AppKit view for integration with macOS menu items. It handles wrapping SwiftUI views in an NSViewRepresentable to enable embedding in native menus and manages sizing and updates of the hosted view.

classes.name: MenuHostedItem
classes.description: A struct conforming to NSViewRepresentable that wraps a SwiftUI view for embedding into an AppKit menu item.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and returns an NSHostingView initialized with the root SwiftUI view.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the existing NSHostingView with a new root view and applies sizing.

methods.name: applySizing
methods.description: Configures the size of the NSHostingView based on specified width and the view's fitting size.
